params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If passed, list below is an object name (string) representing the list in the form; if omitted, list is a hierarchical list reference number (ListRef).

params.name: list
params.description: List reference number (if leading * omitted) or name of the list-type form object (if leading * passed).

params.name: value
params.description: Character string to search for (supports '@' wildcard).

sentinelValues.meaning: limit the search to the first (main) level of the list
extend the search to all sublists

params.name: itemsArray
params.description: Filled by the command with the positions (if trailing * omitted) or reference numbers (if trailing * passed) of every matching item; created/resized automatically.

params.name: asReference
params.description: If passed, work with absolute reference numbers of items; if omitted, work with current item positions.

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the position or reference number of the first list item matching value (0 if none found), optionally filling itemsArray with every match.

constraints: If only a single representation of the list is used, or item reference numbers are worked with (the second * omitted), either syntax may be used; if several representations of the same list exist and item positions are used, the object-name syntax (leading *) is required since positions vary per representation.
Matching is exact ('is exactly'); use the '@' wildcard in value for begins-with/ends-with/contains searches.
